source_policy: Actual own P1 K8 causal rollout of per-fold/seed T1 MIXED inner-selected checkpoint; never oracle positive bank
continuous_current_frames: All target frames after sole click, FIT and INNER only; outer future truth/features never in T2 fitting
risk_stride_budget_reason: Prespecified bounded paired branches over all scenes/targets/three seeds, rather than selecting high-error/best episodes
paired_branch: Copy actual pre-proposal causal state. Both branches process same current/future candidates: one commits own selected current observation, the other omits that write. Both thereafter use actual own P1 predictions/writes for next up-to-10 frames. No runtime branch consumes GT. Seal both trajectories before offline label evaluation.
future_labels: Only after branch/runtime sealing, strict TRAIN/inner candidate matching identifies competitive frames with target AND verified other candidates. Unmatched candidates are UNKNOWN, not guessed hard negatives.
future_safe_label: Verified current correct identity AND at least one competitive next-10 frame AND projected identity margin does not fall by more than 0.02 on mean competitive frames AND correct future selections do not decrease AND verified wrong-person selections do not increase relative to no-current-write branch
future_margin: Actual source T1 model candidate-logit true-target minus hardest verified-other, on each branch's own causal state, same future frame/candidate axis
unknown_current_identity_or_no_future_co: Risk label UNKNOWN, masked from risk loss; never invented safe
new_module: Independent future-safe 18-input MLP 64->1 on current evidence/ranking/availability; current correctness head retained separately
risk_training_input: CURRENT state/candidates only; future trajectories and labels are supervision, never appended as online features
loss: Current candidate/NONE + 0.5 availability + 0.2 verified current correctness, plus 0.5 masked future-safe BCE
future_branch_gradient: Frozen behavior paired rollout labels; not claimed differentiable simulator, perfect causal human intervention, or cross-recording supervision
initialization: Matching T1 MIXED checkpoint for base, seed-initialized future head
checkpoint_selection: INNER full-axis current loss + masked paired-risk loss only
safe_thresholds: Frozen engineering operating point, not selected from outer outcomes; any subsequent calibration is separately versioned and INNER-only
T3: Still requires lawful CHIRLA media and isolated official benchmark lineage; this protocol cannot substitute for it
